help.label: Activation
help.description: An activation occurs when an effect successfully triggers.

help.label: All
help.description: All relevant instances of the concept that follows.

help.label: Attack
help.description: An Attack card or a count of Attack cards.

help.label: Common Attack
help.description: A Common Attack card or a count of Common Attack cards.

help.label: Rare Attack
help.description: A Rare Attack card or a count of Rare Attack cards.

help.label: Uncommon Attack
help.description: An Uncommon Attack card or a count of Uncommon Attack cards.

help.label: Average
help.description: A mean value: the total divided by the relevant number of turns, combats, floors, or activations.

help.label: Block
help.description: Block gained, retained, spent, or otherwise measured by a stat.

help.label: Block gained
help.description: Block added by a card, relic, or other effect.

help.label: Block wasted
help.description: Block that expired or exceeded a retention limit without preventing damage.

help.label: Campfire
help.description: A campfire or rest site on the act map.

help.label: Card
help.description: A card or a count of cards.

help.label: Rare card
help.description: A Rare card or a count of Rare cards.

help.label: Uncommon card
help.description: An Uncommon card or a count of Uncommon cards.

help.label: Charge
help.description: A stored charge accumulated or used by a relic.

help.label: Combat
help.description: A combat encounter or a value measured across combats.

help.label: Damage
help.description: Damage attempted, dealt, blocked, prevented, or otherwise measured by a stat.

help.label: Dexterity
help.description: Dexterity gained, lost, or otherwise measured by a stat.

help.label: Dexterity gained
help.description: Dexterity added by a card, relic, or other effect.

help.label: Discard
help.description: A card discarded or moved to the discard pile.

help.label: Draw
help.description: A card drawn or a count of cards drawn.

help.label: Elite
help.description: An Elite combat destination on the act map.

help.label: Energy
help.description: Energy gained, generated, saved, spent, or otherwise measured by a stat.

help.label: Energy gained
help.description: Energy added by a card, relic, or other effect.

help.label: Energy wasted
help.description: Energy that remained unused or prevented an energy-granting effect from benefiting the player.

help.label: Exhaust
help.description: A card exhausted or moved to the exhaust pile.

help.label: Floor
help.description: A run floor or a value measured across floors.

help.label: Fruit Juice
help.description: The Fruit Juice potion, which permanently increases Max HP.

help.label: Glam
help.description: A card enchanted with Glam.

help.label: Gold
help.description: Gold gained, lost, spent, blocked, or otherwise measured by a stat.

help.label: Gold gained
help.description: Gold added by a card, relic, or other effect.

help.label: Healing blocked
help.description: Healing that was attempted but did not restore HP.

help.label: Healing gained
help.description: HP successfully restored by a healing effect.

help.label: Healing wasted
help.description: Healing that could not restore HP, such as healing offered while already at full HP.

help.label: Information
help.description: Hover this symbol beside a stat to read the row's full description.

help.label: Kill
help.description: An enemy killed by the tracked card, relic, or effect.

help.label: Current HP
help.description: The player's current HP at the observed moment.

help.label: In
help.description: Scopes the preceding stat to the concept that follows.

help.label: Max HP
help.description: Maximum HP gained, lost, or otherwise measured by a stat.

help.label: Maximum HP gained
help.description: Maximum HP added by a relic or other effect.

help.label: Nimble
help.description: A card enchanted with Nimble or a reward containing a Nimble card.

help.label: Offered
help.description: An item or reward presented as a selectable option.

help.label: Osty summon gained
help.description: An increase to Osty's summon amount.

help.label: Per
help.description: Divides the preceding stat by each instance of the concept that follows.

help.label: Potion
help.description: A potion gained, skipped, offered, or otherwise counted by a stat.

help.label: Common potion
help.description: A Common potion or a count of Common potions.

help.label: Potion gained
help.description: A potion successfully added to the potion belt.

help.label: Rare potion
help.description: A Rare potion or a count of Rare potions.

help.label: Uncommon potion
help.description: An Uncommon potion or a count of Uncommon potions.

help.label: Power
help.description: A Power card or a count of Power cards.

help.label: Common Power
help.description: A Common Power card or a count of Common Power cards.

help.label: Rare Power
help.description: A Rare Power card or a count of Rare Power cards.

help.label: Uncommon Power
help.description: An Uncommon Power card or a count of Uncommon Power cards.

help.label: Relic
help.description: A relic gained, skipped, offered, or otherwise counted by a stat.

help.label: Common relic
help.description: A Common relic or a count of Common relics.

help.label: Relic gained
help.description: A relic successfully added to the player's relic inventory.

help.label: Rare relic
help.description: A Rare relic or a count of Rare relics.

help.label: Uncommon relic
help.description: An Uncommon relic or a count of Uncommon relics.

help.label: Merchant
help.description: A merchant room or a value measured across merchant visits.

help.label: Skill
help.description: A Skill card or a count of Skill cards.

help.label: Common Skill
help.description: A Common Skill card or a count of Common Skill cards.

help.label: Rare Skill
help.description: A Rare Skill card or a count of Rare Skill cards.

help.label: Uncommon Skill
help.description: An Uncommon Skill card or a count of Uncommon Skill cards.

help.label: Stars
help.description: Regent Stars gained, spent, saved, or otherwise measured by a stat.

help.label: Strength
help.description: Strength gained, lost, or otherwise measured by a stat.

help.label: Strength gained
help.description: Strength added by a card, relic, or other effect.

help.label: Swift
help.description: A card enchanted with Swift.

help.label: Taken
help.description: An offered item or reward selected by the player.

help.label: Turn
help.description: A combat turn or a value measured across turns.

help.label: Unknown room
help.description: A question-mark site on the map.

help.label: Upgraded
help.description: A card that received an upgrade, or an upgrade applied to a card.

help.label: Vigor
help.description: Vigor gained, spent, or otherwise measured by a stat.

help.label: Vigor gained
help.description: Vigor added by a card, relic, or other effect.

help.label: Vulnerable
help.description: Vulnerable applied, received, or otherwise measured by a stat.

help.label: Wasted
help.description: A resource that was available or generated but produced no benefit.

help.label: Weak
help.description: Weak applied, received, or otherwise measured by a stat.
